import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
items = [
('A','Existing list/add catalogue API','reliable-catalogue','chore',[],'''Outcome: Capture existing list/add catalogue from src/books.js and src/server.js.
Scope: In-memory GET/POST /books and numeric IDs. Excludes: search, lending, persistence.
Acceptance: Existing routes and ID allocation verified by source inspection only.
Behaviour: Title required; author defaults to empty string; no additional runtime guarantees claimed.
Verification: Inspected src/books.js, src/server.js and test/books.test.js; tests not executed during setup. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: none.'''),
('B','Durable storage and restart recovery','reliable-catalogue','task',[],'''Outcome: Acknowledged catalogue and loan data survive restart, from owner first-version requirement.
Scope: Private versioned local file snapshots using Node fs, stable IDs, serialized atomic replacement, file/directory sync, writer exclusion/recovery, durable idempotency records and backup instructions. Excludes: remote databases and hardware destruction guarantees.
Acceptance: Acknowledge mutations only after durability boundary. Pre-replacement failure preserves previous state. Post-replacement uncertainty pauses mutations and reconciles disk before continuing; do not promise universal rollback. Stable mutation tokens replay identifier/status results without duplicate writes; tokens retained for v1 application lifetime. Replay records never contain pupil labels or request payloads. Corrupt existing files are preserved and startup fails closed; clean first use starts empty. Previously acknowledged data survives process interruption. Second writers are rejected; proven-dead same-host locks recover, ambiguous owners fail closed.
Behaviour: Explicit uncertain/retry guidance, no silent resets, private local data permissions, no pupil logging. Historical backups can retain labels after return; document a finite owner-operated backup retention/deletion procedure separately.
Verification: Isolated temporary-directory tests for write/rename/sync failures, termination around replace/sync/ack, simultaneous startup, abandoned-lock restart, concurrent mutations, idempotent retry and absence of pupil labels from replay records. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: single writer on local filesystem supporting atomic replacement and sync; runtime store under data/.'''),
('C','Search and validated catalogue API','reliable-catalogue','task',['B'],'''Outcome: Teacher finds books by title or author, from owner scope and README.
Scope: Case-insensitive substring search via GET /books query, empty query lists all, validated add-copy endpoint, bounded body, consistent HTTP errors, mutation token validation and storage adapter. Excludes: lending and browser UI.
Acceptance: Title/author matches returned; no match yields empty list. Invalid JSON/title and oversized bodies return errors without crashing. IDs stable and duplicate-title physical copies allowed. Retrying add with the same token never duplicates a copy. Storage failures and uncertain outcomes are explicit; reads reflect reconciled state.
Behaviour: Consistent 400/404/413/500 responses as applicable, no stack/private-data leakage, empty list is valid.
Verification: HTTP tests for search, empty/no-match cases, malformed/oversized requests, storage failure and idempotent retries. Prerequisites: B durable storage. Assumptions: each catalogue record represents one physical copy.'''),
('D','Lending, returns and availability','lending','task',['B','C'],'''Outcome: Teacher lends a copy to a pupil and records its return, from owner v1 scope.
Scope: Persistent loans with minimal pupil display label and explicit YYYY-MM-DD due date, one active loan per copy, transactional availability and idempotent lend/return endpoints. Excludes: overdue query/display (deferred), accounts, fines and notifications.
Acceptance: Concurrent double lending rejected; unknown IDs, invalid dates and blank pupil labels rejected. Return makes copy available; repeat return is harmless. Book/loan state persists atomically across restart. Replay results contain no pupil labels. Returning removes pupil label from current application-managed state; historical backup retention follows documented policy.
Behaviour: Explicit conflicts, failures and uncertain outcomes; reconcile before declaring success or rollback. Safe same-token retries do not duplicate loans or returns.
Verification: State-machine, HTTP, concurrency, active/returned restart and uncertain-retry tests; inspect current state and replay records for label removal after return. Prerequisites: B storage and C safe API adapter. Assumptions: physical-copy records; teacher supplies due date for later overdue functionality.'''),
('F','Teacher browser workflow and operating instructions','teacher-workspace','task',['C','D'],'''Outcome: Teacher completes v1 find/lend/return journey with restart retention, from owner scope and delegated UI choice.
Scope: Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript served by existing Node server, local-only bind, catalogue search/add, loan date entry, availability and return controls, accessible labels/focus/keyboard, escaped content and clear recovery. Update README to match actual delivered features and document local operation/privacy/backups. Add GET / HTTP 200 and then enable VERIFY with npm start and http://localhost:3000. Excludes: overdue API/view/counters (post-v1 ticket E), public hosting/auth and pupil login.
Acceptance: Teacher finds, lends and returns; durable response precedes success UI. Retry/reload never duplicates mutation. Persistent browser recovery stores only token/action/resource IDs, never pupil labels or form payloads; resolved recovery records are cleared. Unsent/error form input stays in memory only and clears when resolved/cancelled.
Behaviour: Explicit loading, empty, error, success and uncertain-save states; input preserved in memory on failure; duplicate submissions prevented; unresolved token reconciled before retry.
Verification: HTTP/static tests plus documented manual keyboard and synthetic end-to-end journey including restart, injected save failure, reload recovery and browser storage cleanup. Prerequisites: C search/API and D lending; overdue is NOT a dependency. Assumptions: local teacher workstation; no frontend framework.'''),
('G','Checkpoint: review first-version book-room workflow','teacher-workspace','chore',['F'],'''Criteria: Owner reviews synthetic-data demonstration of find/lend/return, due-date entry, empty/failure/recovery states and restart retention. Overdue is explicitly excluded from v1.
Artifact: Running browser workflow and reproducible walkthrough from F.
Prerequisites: F. Only H waits on this checkpoint.
Stage-1 limitation: Ordinary ticket; human approval is not technically enforced. Record the owner's actual review before marking complete.'''),
('H','Checkpoint: accept first version','teacher-workspace','chore',['G'],'''Criteria: Owner accepts finding books, lending, returns and persistence across restart; confirms local-only boundary, backup guidance and no pupil data tracked in git. Overdue is deferred and is not an acceptance blocker.
Artifact: Application, synthetic-data walkthrough and updated README.
Prerequisites: G workflow review.
Stage-1 limitation: Ordinary ticket; human approval is not technically enforced. Record owner acceptance before completion. Post-v1 work becomes eligible only after this checkpoint is accepted.'''),
('E','Deferred: overdue API and browser list after v1','post-v1-overdue','task',['D','F'],'''Outcome: After v1, teacher sees overdue books, from owner original scope and subsequent explicit deferral.
Scope: Overdue API plus accessible browser list showing book, pupil and due date; documentation. Excludes: reminders and fines.
Acceptance: Active loans dated before server-local today appear; today and returned loans excluded. Browser displays useful empty state and accessible results.
Behaviour: Loading/error/retry states, safe rendering, keyboard/labels, injectable clock.
Verification: Fixed-clock date boundary and returned-loan API tests plus synthetic browser demonstration. Prerequisites: D loan model and F teacher workspace. Assumptions: server-local calendar day documented.
DEFERRED: Do not select or implement until H first-version acceptance is recorded. H is an operational release gate, not a fabricated technical blockedBy dependency. No v1 ticket depends on this work.''')]
ids={}
for label,title,phase,typ,deps,desc in items:
    r=subprocess.run(['storybloq','ticket','create','--title',title,'--type',typ,'--phase',phase,'--stdin','--format','json'],input=desc,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
    payload=json.loads(r.stdout)
    data=payload['data']
    print(json.dumps({'label':label,'created':data}),flush=True)
    ids[label]=data.get('displayId') or data['id']
for label,title,phase,typ,deps,desc in items:
    if deps:
        r=subprocess.run(['storybloq','ticket','update',ids[label],'--blocked-by',*[ids[d] for d in deps]],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
        print(r.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
subprocess.run(['storybloq','ticket','update',ids['A'],'--status','complete'],check=True)
Path('/tmp/shelfmate-setup-ids.json').write_text(json.dumps(ids))
print('IDS '+json.dumps(ids))
PY"
